summary: Joanna Kearney of County Tipperary, born about 1750, once recorded as Patrick's mother but disproven as an ancestor of John.
bio: Joanna Kearney was born in County Tipperary, Ireland, about 1750 and died in Ireland. She was once recorded as the mother of Patrick, but that link has since been disproved, and she is not an ancestor of John.
